title: Personalizing LLM Agent Memory Using Biometrics
mechanism: Add a per-memory biometric/identity embedding field (analogous to Bio-Memory's face/palmprint vector) and use it to pre-filter the recall candidate pool by requester identity before semantic RRF ranking — i.e. an identity-gated prefilter stage inserted ahead of the existing CHITTA_RECALL_PREFILTER pass in field_memory_recall.cpp

expected_gain.rationale: chitta has realm-scoped isolation (realm=<project>) but no per-user biometric identity gating within a shared realm; paper's 21-27% F1 gain assumes true multi-user contention chitta doesn't yet model, so gain here is speculative and likely smaller since realm partitioning already does coarse isolation

cost.scope: chitta/src/handlers/field_memory_recall.cpp, chitta-field/src/store.rs (schema change for identity embedding column), chitta-mcp/server.py recall_gateway, plus a biometric capture/enrollment pipeline not present anywhere in this codebase

evidence.claim: Bio-Memory augments each atomic memory note with a biometric embedding and forms the retrieval candidate pool via biometric matching before semantic ranking (abstract)
reports up to 27.29%/21.15% F1/BLEU-1 owner-vs-non-owner separation gap on CALFW under face-based personalization (abstract)

Dataset provenance: Zheng, Deng and Hu introduce Cross-Age LFW (CALFW), with 3,000 positive face pairs selected to include age gaps; the biometric-memory performance numbers are from Qian et al., not this dataset paper.
